What happens next: DHS will send outreach workers to offer shelter and support to people staying on or near the site. Some sites take a few weeks to address, but DHS will keep track of this area until the problem is resolved.   If the conditions pose a health or safety risk, DHS will work with other City agencies to clean the area.  DHS counts on New Yorkers like you to keep our city safe and livable. If you notice a new condition at the site or if it gets much worse, please file a new request.
